name: Roofing Inbound Calls

hero.headline: Roofing Inbound Calls
hero.subheadline: Connect with high-intent consumers actively looking for roofing solutions.

overview: Roofing Inbound Calls are consumers who see an offer and dial in themselves, generated by Altarious Global performance campaigns and delivered to your business in real time. Reach homeowners needing roof repair or full replacement, including storm damage and insurance claims, and connect them with licensed roofers.

A homeowner watching water drip through a ceiling, or looking at shingles scattered across the lawn after a storm, wants to speak to a roofer immediately. Inbound Call programs place local roofing offers in front of these homeowners and connect them directly to the contractor's office, where staff can schedule an inspection while urgency is highest. In storm-affected markets, inbound programs can be activated within days of an event to reach homeowners before out-of-town crews saturate the area, and calls arrive with the homeowner already expecting an inspection appointment.

This product is suited to home services businesses with a team ready to answer during defined hours, a clear view of the consumer they want, and the capacity to convert a live conversation. The acquisition objective is simple: put your team in front of roofing consumers at the moment they are deciding.
targetConsumer: Owners of single-family homes with roofs approaching or past their expected service life, and homeowners in regions recently affected by hail, wind or hurricane events. The most valuable segments are full replacement candidates, storm damage claimants working with their insurer, and homeowners whose carrier has required a roof replacement to maintain coverage.
consumerIntent: Typical intent signals include: searching for roofing contractors or roof replacement cost; active leak or water stains on ceilings after rain; recent hail, wind or hurricane event in the area; missing, curling or granule-shedding shingles observed.
howGenerated: Calls are generated through call-only and click-to-call performance campaigns targeting searches such as "roofing contractors near me" and "roof replacement cost", alongside social and comparison placements. Every source is tracked, so call quality can be traced back to the campaign that produced it.
qualification: Qualification is configured to your appetite. Standard roofing criteria include: owns a single-family or small multi-family property within the service area; roof type and approximate age identified; nature of the need established as repair, replacement or storm damage inspection; whether an insurance claim has been or will be filed; homeowner available to schedule an on-site inspection or estimate; not currently under contract with another roofing company.
delivery: Calls are routed to your sales line in real time by state or ZIP, schedule and agent availability, with concurrency limits and daily caps set to your capacity. Call tracking and recording are available for quality control.

faq.q: Can programs be launched quickly after a storm event?
faq.a: Yes. Storm response campaigns can be deployed in affected ZIP codes within days, with screening tuned to identify hail or wind damage and insurance claim intent.

faq.q: Can we focus only on full replacements?
faq.a: Screening captures the scope of the need, so contractors can prioritise replacement candidates and limit or exclude minor repair calls.

faq.q: Do you identify insurance claim opportunities?
faq.a: Screening asks whether damage is storm-related and whether a claim has been or will be filed, so transfers can be routed to team members experienced with insurance work.
